title: losing my mind over a niche chess variant is 100% free
summary: Cross Derby leaderboard climb (from 4th place, ~2000) vs online humans: kings trapped in the corners, knights race to the mating squares.
rules: Board has void squares (see setup); pieces cannot stand on or pass through voids? (knights jump so only relevant to pawns/kings).
Each side: king + 5 knights + 8 pawns only.
Kings are boxed into their corner square: a king in the corner can only be mated by knights from the two attacking squares (for a white king on a1: b3 and c2; for black king on h8: f7 and g6).
Normal chess rules otherwise (check, checkmate, promotion).
win_condition: Checkmate (knight to the mating square) or on time; goal: #1 on the Cross Derby leaderboard.

board.shape_notes: 8x8 with 12 void squares: kings and one knight each sit on detached corner squares (a1/h1, a8/h8); ranks 1-2 and 7-8 only have the c-f files (plus the corners); ranks 3-6 full width.
board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream; voids drawn as the dark page background

setup: Cross Derby start (from frame crop 7REcDCBnXZ8_board_layout / wqaQeZHJKhk_cross_board): VOID squares (not part of board): b1,g1,a2,b2,g2,h2,a7,b7,g7,h7,b8,g8. White: Ka1 (isolated corner), Nh1 (isolated corner), Nc1 Nd1 Ne1 Nf1, pawns c2 d2 e2 f2, pawns a3 b3 g3 h3. Black mirror-rotated: Na8, Kh8, Nc8 Nd8 Ne8 Nf8, pawns c7 d7 e7 f7, pawns a6 b6 g6 h6. FEN-with-voids (* = void): n*nnnn*k/**pppp**/pp4pp/8/8/PP4PP/**PPPP**/K*NNNN*N w - - 0 1. No castling. Pawns double-step from start (inferred).
